title: Value of the Base Expression
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $n$ be a natural number, let $z$ be a finite binary string, and let $e$ be a register state whose input-length register equals $n$ and whose fixed-string-length register equals $|z|$. The value at $e$ of the base linear expression for $M$ is $n+2+|z|+W(i+1)$, where $i$ is the instruction register and $W$ is the table width determined by $M$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine M over the binary alphabet
The input-length register of e equals n
The fixed-string-length register of e equals the length of z
